bury.definition:
v. cover from sight
v. place in a grave or tomb
v. place in the earth and cover with soil
v. embed deeply

bury the hatches.translation: 休战,和解,言归于好,化干戈为玉帛

bury's disease.translation: [医] 布厄里氏病, 持久隆起红斑

buryat.translation: n. 布里亚特人; 布里亚特语（等于Buriat）

buryats.translation: (buryat 的复数) n. 布里亚特人; 布里亚特语（等于Buriat）

burying.definition: n. concealing something under the ground
